0022600118.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-2, 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West) in their third game of the 2026-27 season, and the teams have not met yet this season. Sacramento will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), with Murray averaging 7.0 points in 27.2 minutes this season after 14.0 points in 34.5 minutes last season. Memphis is missing Zach Edey (ankle), while Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Karim Lopez (knee bruise) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; the Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3 but won the most recent meeting 123-114 in Memphis on February 23, 2026.
